title: May 15, 2018 Austin City Council Discussion
transcript:
AUSTIN CITY COUNCIL 
 
COUNCIL DISCUSSION 
TUESDAY, MAY 15, 2018 
6:30 PM 
AUSTIN CENTRAL LIBRARY 
710 W. CESAR CHAVEZ ST. 
AUSTIN, TX   78701 
 
 
Citywide Budget Engagement Discussion 
 
6:30 PM   Open House concerning the City’s new community outcomes and alignment of the 
City’s budget with Strategic Direction 2023 for an outcome-based budget. 
 
7:15 PM 
Budget Engagement facilitated discussion, hosted by Mayor Steve Adler and City 
Manager Spencer Cronk and presented by City staff; and opportunity for public 
participation. 
 
 
A quorum of Council members may be present. No action will be taken. 
 
The City of Austin is committed to compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. 
Reasonable modifications and equal access to communications will be provided upon request. 
For assistance, please call 512-974-2210 or TTY users route through 711.
